## Why it happens

Wrong IP address, port or unit ID; wrong serial settings; the PLC is off or unreachable; or the polling period is too short for the device.

## Fix it

Check the connector's IP address, port (502), unit ID and, for serial, port, baud rate, parity and stop bits. Ping the device from the gateway machine. Lengthen the polling period if many reads time out.

## Check that it worked

Values arrive on the device's **Latest telemetry** tab.
